$comment: Machine-readable style lock for the working theme SWAMP FUNK. Every generation prompt is rendered from art/bible/prompts/*.txt using these values; see docs/ART_BIBLE.md for the human-readable version and rationale. Symbol ids match src/games/swamp-funk/config.ts. Values marked 'calibrate' are starting thresholds, to be tuned on the approved paintover pack.

theme.status: working theme (placeholder, swappable). Swapping the theme = new palette, briefs and mascots; the rules below (outline, light, extrusion, canvas, gates) stay.
theme.setting: Neon bayou juke joint at night: string lights, cypress silhouettes behind the windows, a shelf of glowing firefly jars on the left, a neon gator sign (icon only, no letters) and a magenta booth on the right.
theme.referenceQualityTarget: Match the quality, layout and energy of a premium Stake Engine 7x5 cluster slot. Never copy its IP, characters, names or palette-as-identity.

styleFormula: Premium 2D slot-game art, bold cel shading: one flat base tone, two hard-edged shadow tones and one crisp white specular streak, no soft gradients, no texture noise. Uniform thick pure-black outline around every shape with thinner black interior lines; chunky rounded exaggerated forms with a short dark-plum extrusion toward the lower right. Key light from the upper left on every object. Warm saturated candy colours for symbols and characters, molten gold for special features; foreground objects carry no rim light or glow, neon exists only in the deep violet-indigo environment. Clean readable silhouettes, adult characters.
styleFormulaRules: Paste byte-identical into every image prompt. Never edit it per asset; per-asset needs go in the subject line or the suffix.

Supersedes the earlier Higgsfield-brief formula (dark-plum outline, cyan rim light, glossy sheen). The reference was pixel-measured: pure-black outlines, plum only in the extrusion, no rim light or neon on foreground assets.
Keying/background words never go in the formula; they go in the per-kind suffix.
No brand, studio, artist or existing-game names in any prompt (IP hygiene; also avoids vendor 'ip_detected' failures).

suffixes.symbol: Single object, centred, filling {FILL_PCT}% of the frame height with equal empty margin on all four sides, upright, no text, no letters, no numbers. On a solid uniform flat {KEY_HEX} background, no gradient, no vignette, no cast shadow, no floor, no glow on the background, nothing cropped at the edges.
suffixes.symbolEdit: Same symbol as the reference: identical silhouette, outline thickness, colours, framing and flat {KEY_HEX} background. Change only: {CHANGE}.
suffixes.mascotDesignSheet: Solid uniform flat {KEY_HEX} background, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows.
suffixes.mascot3dInput: Single full-body figure, orthographic {VIEW} view, relaxed A-pose with arms held away from the torso and legs slightly apart, flat unlit colours, no outlines, no cel shadows, no specular, plain 50% grey #808080 background, no floor, no cast shadow, whole figure in frame with margin.
suffixes.background: No characters, no UI elements, no text, no letters, no readable signage, no logos. Darker, lower-detail area in the central 60% where the reel grid sits; brightest neon masses at the far left and far right edges; thinner, lower-contrast linework than the foreground; soft depth layering.
suffixes.framePiece: Single game UI element, orthographic front view, crisp edges, no drop shadow outside the element, no text, no neon, no glow. Any enclosed opening is solid flat {KEY_HEX}. Solid uniform flat {KEY_HEX} background.
suffixes.vfxKey: Single effect element, centred, on a solid uniform flat {KEY_HEX} background, no text, no characters, hard-edged cel-shaded shapes, pure-black outline where shapes are solid.

rules: The same hex goes into the prompt and into the keyer.
The keyer must also clear ENCLOSED key-coloured regions (holes, handles, frame openings).
ffmpeg despill supports green/blue only; magenta-keyed assets rely on the closed black outline (outline_matte) or ToonOut/BiRefNet matting.
Alternative for Nano Banana: render the same edit once on #FFFFFF and once on #000000 and difference-matte for true soft alpha.

palette.role: All outer outlines and interior lines, foreground and mascots.
Extrusion toward the lower right (royals, symbols, logo). Never used as an outline.
One crisp specular streak per object.
Light-tone tint (warm cream) for cel highlights.
Shadow tones shift toward warm plum, never toward grey or black.
Molten gold for specials, coins, the boombox and the mic.
Ambient indigo-blue fill light in the background only.
Floor / deepest background; also the app clear colour.
Background neon (firefly jars, sign). Foreground never glows.
Glass panel gradient top (drawn in code).
Glass panel gradient bottom (drawn in code).
H2 Vinyl Record (hot pink label/sleeve). Same hue as background neon: must read as flat enamel, never glowing.
W Wild (teal enamel + gold). Flat enamel, no glow baked.
HUD labels (condensed caps, 2 px black stroke).
Small hex button stroke (2 px) over 85% black fill.
The ONLY saturated UI accent: bonus-buy button.

heatTiers.$comment: Multiplier-spot tile skins, drawn in code (src/games/swamp-funk/config.ts SPOT_BANDS decides which tier a value gets). Measured on the reference; SWAMP FUNK reskin proposal: lily pads under glass, teal -> lime -> orange -> gold.

T1.note: marked, teal/gold payframe glow, no number

outline.note: 1 design px = 2 px on the 360 @2x canvas = ~5.7 px on a 2048 master. Research round 2's '14 px at 2048, darkened local hue' is superseded: it would render ~1.2 design px and does not match the reference.

extrusion.direction: lower-right (away from the top-left key light)
extrusion.note: The outline wraps the face and the extrusion together.

light.key: top-left, 45 degrees, on every asset (symbols, mascots, frame, logo, 3D)
light.cel: 1 flat base + 2 hard-edged shadow tones + 1 white specular streak; no gradients except runtime glows

camera.symbols: one camera for every object symbol: frontal three-quarter, slight low angle; royals straight-on
camera.mascots: three-quarter, turned toward the reels (Gumbo faces screen-right, Croak screen-left)

canvas.rotationNote: The runtime rotates each symbol by restAngle (src/games/swamp-funk/config.ts). Deliver art upright. For negative restAngle (counter-clockwise tilt) ask for the key light a little more from above (by about |restAngle|) so it still reads top-left after rotation.

cellFill.$comment: Content height as % of the 150 px cell; matches src/games/swamp-funk/config.ts cellScale.

promptFillPctOfFrame.note: Generation framing only (leaves margin for the matte). The matte/fit step rescales content onto the 360 @2x canvas to hit the cellFill height above.

H1.motionIdeas: Speaker cones pump on land_impact and win_peak; antenna jiggles via physics.

H2.label: Vinyl Record
H2.brief: Glossy black vinyl record half out of a hot-pink sleeve, blank label (no text), grooves as 2-3 interior lines only.
H2.motionIdeas: Disc spins in win_loop; sleeve squashes on land.

H3.label: Crawfish
H3.brief: Adult-proportioned cartoon crawfish, red-orange shell, big claws raised in a swagger pose, two long antennae; attitude, not cute.
H3.motionIdeas: Claws snap on win_peak; antennae trail the drop via setPositionInheritance.

H4.label: Hot Sauce
H4.brief: Bayou hot-sauce bottle, deep red sauce, cork/cap, blank label with a chili pictogram (no words), small cartoon flame wisp.
H4.motionIdeas: Sauce sloshes on land; cap pops on win_peak.

royalsCommon.brief: Chunky carved-wood letterform with a glossy coloured enamel face (one hue per letter), pure-black outline, plum extrusion lower-right. Built as vector geometry from the bundled display fonts (Lilita One / Titan One), rasterised with resvg; optional AI material pass (royal_material_pass.txt) re-matted and registered back onto the vector alpha.

rules.adultProportions: Head about 1/4 of total height (head:body >= 1:3). Adult body language and attire. Stake rejects child-like characters in any gambling context.
rules.identityLock: Exactly the same character as the references: same face, markings, outfit and colours; nothing added, removed or recoloured; same proportions.

readability64.method: Contact sheet of every symbol at 64 px, plus 150 and 75 px on the real panel colour; Claude + Gemini identify each blind.
readability64.pass: every symbol identified by both judges

silhouetteConfusion.method: Greyscale/alpha silhouettes of all symbols, pairwise aligned-IoU confusion matrix.

paletteDeltaE.method: k-means dominant colours per asset vs bible role colours (CIEDE2000).
paletteDeltaE.pass: every dominant cluster within 10 dE of an allowed role colour; hidden-area fills < 3 dE vs the visible part
paletteDeltaE.status: calibrate (the 3 dE fill rule is from research; the 10 dE cluster rule is a starting value)

outlineHistogram.method: OpenCV distance-transform width histogram of dark (max RGB < 70) boundary pixels at final display size.
outlineHistogram.pass: outer outline 3-5 design px (bottom-right up to 7); >= 3 px for baked 3D inserts

styleSimilarity.method: DINOv2 cosine similarity to the canonical paintover pack; mascot identity vs the canonical front view.

halo.method: Composite on pure black and pure white; count key-tinted edge pixels.

canvasAndPivot.method: 360x360 @2x, content bbox height within the cellFill range, content centred, straight alpha.

adultProportions.method: Head bbox height / total height + vision rubric.
adultProportions.pass: <= 0.27 and judged adult by both judges

lightDirection.method: Vision rubric on the rotated in-game composite.

gates.retryBudget: 2 automatic regenerations per asset, then best-of goes to human review.

bassDrop.$comment: Bass Drop (docs/games/bass-drop) additions. Same world, key-colour rules and gates as SWAMP FUNK above, but a different finish: docs/games/bass-drop/STYLE_DECISION.md adopted formula D (foreground) and the painted-environment formula (backgrounds) after three Higgsfield A/B rounds. Bass Drop prompts pass them as --var STYLE_FORMULA=...; the SWAMP FUNK values above stay untouched so every recorded job in art/ledger/higgsfield-jobs.json keeps reproducing. Per-asset briefs below reach the templates as --var (art/plan/build_plan.py resolves them into art/plan/bass-drop.json; docs/games/bass-drop/ART_PLAN.md is the human plan). No brand, studio, artist or game names, none of mascots.rules.forbiddenPromptWords, and none of bannedPromptWords.
bassDrop.styleFormula: Premium hand-painted slot-game art with a clean, confident, single-weight bold black outline around every shape and thinner dark interior lines. Rich painterly rendering inside the lines: smooth layered shading with soft gradients, saturated jewel-tone colours, strong key light from the upper left with a warm bounce light and a thin cool rim light, glossy lacquered highlights and crisp white specular hotspots, fine surface detail that stays readable at small size. Chunky, rounded, heroic proportions with clear three-dimensional volume; polished and expensive-looking; adult characters.
bassDrop.environmentFormula: Hand-painted premium slot-game environment, painterly soft brushwork, atmospheric perspective with softer and bluer detail in the distance, rich violet-indigo and teal night palette with warm amber and magenta neon accents, cinematic lighting, high detail at the edges.

bannedPromptWords.why: 'extrusion' draws a separate stick or tab and 'molten' draws drips (STYLE_DECISION.md; say 'polished solid gold'); the game and feature titles would be painted as letters. Checked by art/plan/build_plan.py on every planned Bass Drop prompt (not added to tools/gen/forbidden-words.json, because the SWAMP FUNK formula and briefs still use the first two).

bassDrop.keyColour: Requested per asset as usual, but NOT guaranteed (one formula-D symbol came back on olive): matte with tools/matte/outline_matte.py --key auto (border median), check the border is uniform and close to the requested hex, else regenerate.
bassDrop.look: The SWAMP FUNK neon bayou juke joint turned up to party volume, in a premium hand-painted finish: clean single-weight bold black outlines, painterly soft-gradient rendering, jewel-tone colours, upper-left key light with warm bounce and a thin cool rim, glossy highlights. The reels sit between a speaker stack on the left, whose huge woofer is the Groove Meter, and Baron Croak's DJ booth on the right; two brass horn speakers are bolted on the top corners of the cypress frame. Everything that booms is a speaker: cabinets in dark plum-black wood with gold bolts, charcoal cones and dark glass dust caps. Feature emblems: a gold-and-teal jukebox and a crowned hot-pink speaker stack. Nothing glows in the art: all glow, rings, LEDs and neon pulses are runtime fx.

reuse.symbols: Symbol ids, kinds, tilts and key colours from SWAMP FUNK; subjects rewritten for formula D below (H1, H3 and W are the adopted ab2 images). S (Golden Mic) is unused in Bass Drop.
reuse.royals: L1-L5 stay vector (Lilita One / Titan One + resvg). Under formula D the vector build needs painterly gradient shading to sit next to the symbols; royal_material_pass.txt still says 'extrusion' and 'hard-edged cel', so an AI pass waits for a formula-D version of it (open decision in ART_PLAN.md).
reuse.frame: The SWAMP FUNK cypress frame pieces (frame_piece.txt beam / post / sill / corner cap) rendered with formula D; the horns bolt onto its top corners.
reuse.hud: The SWAMP FUNK hex HUD, vector only (no generation).
reuse.background: The adopted painted-environment plate (ab1 ab_bg_painted) is the Bass Drop base landscape plate.
